title: Sports and competition taxonomy
description: Drives every label, order and grouping on the TV. New sports, competitions, tags and live states arrive here; readers render unknown ids with the generic 'other' fallback instead of dropping them.

icon_key.description: Optional (capability taxonomy_icons): stable key for the sport's icon; unknown keys use the generic icon.

default_sport_order.description: Optional (capability taxonomy_icons): every b1g_priority_group a sport or competition can publish, in the default display order, including groups B1G has no built-in entry for. Append unknown groups after the user's own order.

icon_key.description: Optional (capability taxonomy_icons): stable key for the competition's emblem, where one is available.
